<!-- generated by npm run docs:generate; do not edit -->

Every error answers `{ "error": { "code", "message", "details"? } }` with the HTTP status of the exception. The codes below are read from the exception sites in the code. A validation failure carries `VALIDATION_ERROR` with one entry per field in `details`.

## Generic codes

Thrown by the framework or by an exception raised without an explicit code; the code follows the HTTP status.

- `BAD_REQUEST`: 400
- `UNAUTHORIZED`: 401
- `FORBIDDEN`: 403
- `NOT_FOUND`: 404
- `CONFLICT`: 409
- `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY`: 422
- `RATE_LIMITED`: 429
- `INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR`: 500

## Database codes

A Prisma error the filter maps before it reaches the client.

- Prisma `P2002`: `CONFLICT`, 409. A record with this value already exists.
- Prisma `P2003`: `CONFLICT`, 409. Cannot delete, record is still referenced by another entity.
- Prisma `P2025`: `NOT_FOUND`, 404. The requested record was not found.
